description: This source file defines an observable singleton class `InstancesStore` that manages a list of remote and local instance information, including fetching presence data, handling push notifications, and reporting node connections. It also defines a data structure `InstanceInfo` for representing individual instance details.

classes.name: InstancesStore
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for maintaining and updating a list of active instances, handling presence push events, performing periodic refreshes, and notifying of node connections.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the periodic refresh and sets up push subscription unless in preview mode.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the periodic refresh and removes push subscriptions.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous fetch of presence data and updates the list of instances, with fallback and health probing.

methods.name: localFallbackInstance
methods.description: Creates a fallback `InstanceInfo` representing the local machine when remote data is unavailable.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles incoming push events, triggering presence updates or refresh cycles.

methods.name: decodeAndApplyPresenceData
methods.description: Decodes presence data and applies it to update the current instances.

methods.name: handlePresenceEventPayload
methods.description: Decodes and processes presence event payloads received via push.

methods.name: normalizePresence
methods.description: Converts a list of PresenceEntry objects into InstanceInfo objects with proper IDs.

methods.name: applyPresence
methods.description: Updates the instance list with newly received presence entries and triggers notifications.

methods.name: notifyOnNodeLogin
methods.description: Sends notifications for newly connected nodes based on presence data.

methods.name: snippet
methods.description: Creates a short string preview of data for logging purposes.

methods.name: probeHealthIfNeeded
methods.description: Performs a health check on the system gateway and adds a health status instance to the list.

methods.name: localFallbackInstance
methods.description: Generates a local fallback instance info with details about the current machine.
